convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Bezier_StDev indicator and external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position management and money management logic. Custom indicator buffers require understanding of Bezier_StDev implementation to replicate in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

other_exits: Buy close on DIRECT mode when Bezier line[0] > Bezier line[1] (line rising - exit long on uptrend reversal detection)
Sell close on DIRECT mode when Bezier line[0] < Bezier line[1] (line falling - exit short on downtrend reversal detection)
Buy close on POINT mode when Buffer 3 signal dot is non-zero
Sell close on POINT mode when Buffer 2 signal dot is non-zero

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input (0.1) serves as either lot size (LOT mode) or percentage fraction (other modes).

custom_logic_notes: Entry and exit signal modes are independently configurable via BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose (POINT, DIRECT, WITHOUT). POINT mode uses indicator signal dots (Buffer 2=sell, Buffer 3=buy). DIRECT mode uses Bezier line direction/momentum (3-bar V-bottom for buy open, 3-bar V-top for sell open, 2-bar direction change for closes). WITHOUT mode disables that signal entirely. SignalBar input allows selecting which historical bar to read (default=1, previous bar). The BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/Close functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh handle position gate checks, signal time tracking, and order placement internally.
python_conversion_notes: The Bezier_StDev custom indicator must be ported to Python first - it uses Bezier curve smoothing with standard deviation bands (buffers: 0=main line, 1=likely StDev band, 2=sell signal dots, 3=buy signal dots). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all position management (open/close with position gates, money management modes, signal time deduplication) and must be reimplemented. Key complexity: (1) the 5 MarginMode variants for position sizing, (2) the SignalMode enum providing 3 different signal generation methods per direction per action, (3) the Recount flag mechanism that re-evaluates signals on data errors, (4) GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - 1000 points = 100 pips on 5-digit, check if _Point adjustment needed.
